findings.detail: Require exact owned profile on every live leader, including pre-exec Python shim; avoid requiring cmdline from zombies.
Pre-cleanup receipt write or journal write must not prevent cleanup. Preserve diagnostic failure and fail result without suppressing ownership assertions.
Shim writes identity in place while observer parses as soon as path exists; use atomic publication to avoid empty/partial registration.

accepted: Exact receiver preserved; trusted archived inputs and current candidate pins verified before launch.
Distinct owned Chrome session registry is separate from Node lifetime.
ESRCH handled only after re-observed empty group.
PR67-only workflow, contents read, installed Chrome default sandbox, temporary exact Puppeteer version and no automatic retry.
Original failed native attempt is kept separate.
